fusions.name: Springloaded Nip
fusions.desc: A leaping bite that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times at maximum range. Its damage rises +3% per 100 paces run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Itch Spreader
fusions.desc: Deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Table to Table
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Restless Bounds
fusions.desc: As you move, your next strike gains 30% more critical chance. Once every 8 seconds.
